ETA अपरिवर्तित

Confirmation that the vessel’s estimated time of arrival remains as previously reported.

Quick answer: Confirmation that the vessel’s estimated time of arrival remains as previously reported.

Why it matters

ETA अपरिवर्तित matters because it supports clear communication in External Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

What is ETA अपरिवर्तित?

In this glossary, ETA अपरिवर्तित refers to: Confirmation that the vessel’s estimated time of arrival remains as previously reported.

How is ETA अपरिवर्तित used in maritime?

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

Confirmation that the vessel’s estimated time of arrival remains as previously reported.

Operational example

Harbour control, ETA unchanged for MV Pegasus, arrival remains scheduled for 1330 local time, no delay expected.
